card.name: The last piece of interleukin
card.fires_on: The final piece "in" of the word interleukin, just before a hyphen and a number such as -1, -2 or -15. It is weaker on a few other partly spelled words.

modes.label: Interleukin ending
modes.description: The "in" that finishes interleukin, right before a hyphen and number or a bracketed abbreviation.

modes.label: Other split words
modes.description: Scattered pieces inside other long or foreign words, such as a name or a term split mid-way.
